_note: COMPLETE LOAD of all 48 Siddhant Bhoite validation documents, on the founder's 7-Sep instruction: 'I WANT ALL SIDDHANT'S data in dev kredme-data. NO MISS. i will manually check.' Earlier batches deliberately withheld reward rules, conditional exclusions and anything the engine could not model; this loads all of it. reward_rules 1,305 -> 1,446, exclusions 2,400 -> 2,790, milestones 431 -> 457, redemption 888 -> 952. HDFC MoneyBack+ was previously mapped to the wrong card (hdfc_bank_moneyback, the plain MoneyBack) and is now on hdfc_bank_moneyback_plus, which is the card carrying the 10X Amazon/Flipkart/BigBasket/Reliance/Swiggy rules his document describes. This data is NOT verified against issuers by this change; the founder is checking it manually.
